args.title: Use correct public URL instead of localhost in password reset email link
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently hardcodes a default base URL pointing to http://localhost:3000 when the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This causes links in the email to be incorrect for users outside of local development.

The proposed change is to ensure that the BASE_URL is correctly sourced from the configuration or environment so that the password reset email and other notification emails generate links with the proper public-facing URL rather than localhost. This will fix the problem where the reset-password link in the email goes to localhost for users in production.
